title: PlanBrief
description: The plan node's result in M1 (P22a-5c-3; #226 entries 103 and 117): a blob the controller publishes from the task's own record, holding only its spec's title and requirement, never its acceptance, and naming the spec's digest and the digest of its project's data policy. Its ref is a root (no lineage): the I18 walk (internal/intent) honours a plan node's ref only as its own task's brief under the project's data policy now, its content digest the digest of exactly these bytes.

spec_digest.description: The digest of the task's spec, as the task records it.

policy_digest.description: The digest of the project's data policy the brief was planned under: the canonical (RFC 8785) bytes of the recorded profile's data_policy. A policy change makes another brief.
